review_candidates.title: Key Account officer
review_candidates.description: This job description outlines a tech-driven operations and account management role tailored specifically for a licensed pharmacist in Jordan. It bridges traditional pharmaceutical operations with B2B healthcare technology. Job Overview Role: Key Account Officer (Pulse-Marketplace) Company: Aumet Target Candidate: Pharmacists looking to transition from clinical or retail pharmacy into B2B tech/operations. Core Goal: Drive engagement on Aumet's marketplace platform, manage relationships between pharmacies and distributors, and optimize delivery performance. Key Acronyms & Terminology Defined AFH (Order Fulfillment / Logistics Metrics): Refers to monitoring the order lifecycle from order placement to delivery by distributors. SLA (Service Level Agreement): The promised delivery timeframe and performance standards distributors must hit. FTTR (First-Time Resolution Rate): The percentage of pharmacy support tickets or inquiries resolved on the first interaction without escalation. Platform Stickiness: Creating user habits so pharmacies consistently use the Aumet platform for routine ordering rather than offline channels. Core Skill Sets Required Domain Expertise B.Sc. in Pharmacy, clinical/retail pharmacy background, immediate availability Tech & Tools CRMs (Salesforce, Zendesk, HubSpot), dashboard analytics, chatbot workflows Soft Skills Arabic & English fluency, negotiation, conflict resolution/de-escalation Operational Focus SLA monitoring, churn prevention, product feedback loops with Tech/Product teams
